evidence.claim: Trafag dal 1942 serve applicazioni industriali in tutto il mondo con soluzioni standard, configurabili e su misura per OEM e system integrator.
evidence.quote: Founded in 1942 and headquartered in Bubikon, Switzerland, we serve demanding industrial applications worldwide with a broad portfolio of standardized, configurable and tailor-made solutions. || Supported by production facilities in Switzerland, Germany, the Czech Republic and India, we ensure high quality standards and reliable delivery worldwide. || we help OEMs, system integrators and operators meet demanding quality, safety and operational requirements under extreme conditions.
